visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A grey-faced buzzard with mottled brown and grey plumage is captured from a high-angle tracking shot, gliding steadily over a vast, turquoise and deep blue ocean. The bird's wings are spread wide, showing distinct primary feather tips, and it occasionally flaps with slow, controlled movements. The setting is bright with natural daylight, and the background consists of calm sea water with subtle white ripples. (2) The camera follows the hawk as it maintains its flight path, transitioning from the open sea towards a coastal landscape. A shoreline with grey pebbles is briefly visible at the bottom of the frame before the scene shifts to the bird flying over a lush green mountainside covered in dense tropical forest and shrubs. The lighting remains bright and clear, emphasizing the contrast between the bird and the vibrant green foliage. (3) The bird descends slightly, flying closer to the canopy of the forest. In the foreground, vibrant green leaves and a few small purple flowers appear as the hawk glides past. The camera continues to track the bird's smooth motion against the backdrop of the forested hill, eventually moving towards a thicker area of vegetation as the bird flies into the distance.
